title: Stale tickers no longer pollute ranking screens
points: Suspended or frozen tickers whose prices had not updated in months were producing nonsensical values in "top N" screens — for example, a ticker stuck at an old price showing a dividend yield above 1,000%.

Every ranking screen (dividend yield, market cap, PE, PB, enterprise value) now applies a mandatory 30-day staleness filter: tickers whose latest market data is more than 30 days behind the freshest date are excluded from the ranking entirely.
Tickers with a missing (NULL) value for the ranked metric are also excluded, instead of being silently treated as zero.
